mapper.insert: INSERT INTO node_extension_config ( node_id, spi_interface, extension_name, class_name, source_code, description, enabled, extension_mode ) VALUES ( #{nodeId, typeHandler=com.helianhealth.agent.common.typehandler.ListIntegerTypeHandler}, #{spiInterface}, #{extensionName}, #{className}, #{sourceCode}, #{description}, #{enabled}, #{extensionMode} )
mapper.update: UPDATE node_extension_config SET node_id = #{nodeId, typeHandler=com.helianhealth.agent.common.typehandler.ListIntegerTypeHandler}, class_name = #{className}, source_code = #{sourceCode}, description = #{description}, enabled = #{enabled}, extension_name = #{extensionName}, extension_mode = #{extensionMode} WHERE code_id = #{codeId}
